    p.snd }

def relState (id : w64) (s : NState) (k : Nat) : NState :=
  { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox,
    stepfn := s.stepfn, ticking := s.ticking, progress := s.progress, log := s.log, logst := s.logst, prvals := s.prvals,
    prevote := s.prevote, gh := s.gh,
    rd :=
      have __src := s.rd;
      { states := __src.states, ro := readonlyRelease s.rd.ro id s.logst.committed (List.take k s.rd.pend) },
    lt := s.lt, pci := s.pci, isLearner := s.isLearner, sdr := s.sdr, cq := s.cq }

theorem heartbeatOk_transfer (id : w64) (s t : NState) (m : Msg) (Hterm : t.term = s.term) (Hcm :
    t.logst.committed = s.logst.committed) (Hrole : t.role = s.role) (Hmm : prvalsMatch t.prvals =
    prvalsMatch s.prvals) (H : HeartbeatOk id (toPState t) m) : HeartbeatOk id (toPState s) m

theorem readonlyRelease_take_succ (r : ReadOnly) (id c : w64) (pend : List (MessageM × List EntryM))
    (k : Nat) (p : MessageM × List EntryM) (Hp : pend[k]? = some p) : readonlyRelease r id c
    (List.take (k + 1) pend) = readonlyArrive (readonlyRelease r id c (List.take k pend)) id { index
    := c, src := p.fst.From', ents := p.snd }

theorem relState_full (id : w64) (s : NState) : relState id s s.rd.pend.length = releasedState id s

theorem released_nil (id : w64) (s : NState) (Hpend : s.rd.pend = []) : (have __src := sendMsgs
    (releasedState id s) []; { term := __src.term, vote := __src.vote, lead := __src.lead, role :=
    __src.role, votes := __src.votes, outbox := __src.outbox, stepfn := __src.stepfn, ticking :=
    __src.ticking, progress := __src.progress, log := __src.log, logst := __src.logst, prvals :=
    s.prvals, prevote := __src.prevote, gh := __src.gh, rd := __src.rd, lt := __src.lt, pci :=
    __src.pci, isLearner := __src.isLearner, sdr := __src.sdr, cq := __src.cq }) = s

theorem pend_nil_eq (s : NState) (Hpend : s.rd.pend = []) : { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead
    := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, stepfn := s.stepfn, ticking :=
    s.ticking, progress := s.progress, log := s.log, logst := s.logst, prvals := s.prvals, prevote
    := s.prevote, gh := s.gh, rd :=
        have __src := s.rd;
        { states := __src.states, ro := __src.ro },
      lt := s.lt, pci := s.pci, isLearner := s.isLearner, sdr := s.sdr, cq := s.cq } =
    s
